newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan seeks 30,000 T white sugar for Nov/Dec.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks 30,000 T white sugar for Nov/Dec.

text.p: Jordan is seeking to buy 30,000 tonnes of white refined or white crystal sugar for delivery in the second half of November and first half of December, traders said on Thursday.
The shipment is to be delivered in two lots of 15,000 tonnes each, the first lot during second half November and the second by first half December, they said.
They said offers must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by October 2.
Jordan's average monthly consumption of sugar is estimated at 13,000 tonnes. --Amman Newsroom +9626-623776
